content: Karriburluburlumen Nawu Yawey.
Psalm 147
Karriburluburlumen nawu Yawey! Nungka wanjh God kadberre, dja kamak rowk bu karrimarnewayini nuye. Bu karriburlume nungka wanjh kunmak bu karrikurduyime, dja karrinjilngmak.
Nawu Yawey kabolkmarnbun kunred Jerusalem dja kabenmirndemornname kunmekbe bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng bu birridi kunkuyeng kore kubolkbubuyika.
Mak Yawey kabenkangemarnbun birrimekbe bininj nawu birrikangewarre, dja kabenmarnbun nawu kabirrikarrme kumorninj.
Nawu Yawey nakka nadjalkudji kurrmeng mankokkarrng rowk, dja kabenbebbehngeybun kinjkinj rowk.
Nungka nawu Kawohrnan Rowk, wanjh nadjalngeykimuk dja mak narrulkarrekimuk duninjh. Kaburrbun yehyeng rowk, kunmayali rowk kakarrme.
Nawu Yawey kabennahnan nawu birrimarladj bininj, dja nawu birriwarre bininj, wanjh kabenkukburriwe kurorre.
Mah, wanjh karrimarnewayinin nawu Yawey kore karrimanjmanjbun. Nungka nawu God kadberre, wanjh karrimarnebun nuye kore nawu instruments harps.
Nungka wanjh kangolbarrkbun dja kangolburlerriwon, bu kamunkewe mandjewk kore kurorre rowk. Nungka wanjh kamarnbun kundalk bu kawernmerren kore kurrulum.
Nungka kamarnbun rowk manme manbu bulikki kangun, dja mak manbu mayh nawu ravens bu kakayhme kunmarrwe dorrengh.
Nawu Yawey minj kanjilngmak bu kanan djarrang namak nawu ngudjbang. Dja minj mak kanjilngmak bu kabinan bininj nawu namurrngrayek.
Dja nawu Yawey kawernhnjilngmak bedberre bininj nawu kabirrimarnekele, dja kabirridjalwoybukwon nungka nawu kabenmarnedjare munguyh munguyh.
Ngudda nawu ngurrihni Jerusalem, wanjh ngurringeyburlumen nawu Yawey! Ngudda nawu Zion ngurrihni, wanjh ngurriburluburlumen nawu God ngudberre!
Nungka murrngrayekwong kunrurrk dja kurrang kore ngurrihni kamak rowk, dja ngunmarnekurduyime kunmak ngudda nawu ngurrihni Jerusalem.
Mak nungka ngunkukdjurruddi ba bu birribuyika bininj minj kabirrimre bu ngundibun. Kunmekbekenh wanjh ngurridi kore kunmodmikenh. Dja mak nungka ngunwon manme mandjalmak.
Nawu Yawey kamunkewe nuye kunwok kore kondah kurorre bu kawokrayekwon, dja mahni kunwok nuye wanjh kawarlahmeng werrkwerrk.
Nungka wanjh kaburriwe kubolkwern manbu snow manbu kakukyime wool nawu kukbele. Dja mak kawernhburriwe frost yiman kayime bininj kaburriwe kunburlebele kore kurorre.
Nungka wanjh kawernburriwe hail kore kaddumbeh yiman kayime kunwardde mankilehkilelk. Adju, nangale kahdi kamak bu nungka kabolkmarnbun rowk bu yekke duninjh?
Kaluk yerre wanjh kamunkewe nuye kunwok, dja bonj, kabolkwurlhmen, dja manbu ice wanjh kayawoyhyimerran kukku. Nungka kamunkewe kunmayorrkmak, dja mankabo rowk kayawoyhborlobme.
Nawu Yawey benbukkang nawu Jacob nuye mawahmawah ba bu kabirriwokmang nuye kunwok. Nungka mak benbengdayhkeng bu benwong Israel nuye mawahmawah manbu mankarre dja kunwokrayek nuye rowk.
Nungka minj mak benmarnekurduyimeninj birribuyika bininj nawu birridjenbubuyika. Bedda minj kabirriburrbun nuye mankarre. Mah, wanjh karriwernhburlumen nawu Yawey.
